title: ⚡ Bolt: [performance improvement] Debounce user search API requests
body:
💡 **What:** Added a 300ms debounce to the user search input in the directory modal (`frontend/src/App.jsx`).
🎯 **Why:** The search input was previously firing an API request to `loadDirectoryUsers` on every single keystroke, causing unnecessary network traffic and backend load.
📊 **Impact:** Reduces API requests and React state updates by an estimated 80-90% during fast typing.
🔬 **Measurement:** Open the Network tab in DevTools. Type a name like "mario" quickly. You should now see 1 request instead of 5.
